definitions: An acronym for 'Return to Office,' referring to the policy or process of employees returning to work in a physical office after a period of remote work.

An acronym for 'Recovery Time Objective,' a key metric in business continuity and disaster recovery planning, representing the maximum tolerable duration of time that a computer system, network, or application can be down after a disaster or disruption.
examples: Our company announced a new RTO policy for all departments.
The IT team's RTO for critical systems is set at four hours.
Many employees are discussing the pros and cons of the RTO.
Achieving the RTO after the server crash was a major challenge.
